_description: The sources of the count tables under static/corpus/frequency (format ergopti-count-table): one entry per table, read by tools/build/import-count-tables.cjs, which downloads url (or takes the archive from --archive-dir), refuses it unless its SHA-256 is sha256, reads member from it, counts it with the analysis engine's own rules and writes output. kind: leipzig_sentences (a Leipzig Corpora Collection sentence file, « number<TAB>sentence » per line, counted as text, so bigrams and trigrams cross words) or lexique_words (Lexique's TSV, each distinct word of word_column weighted by the sum of its rows' frequency_column per million, times scale, counted by the word-list rule, so its n-grams stay inside words and at their edges). The licence, attribution, status and prune_ratio of each table are in static/corpus/register.json, their one source: prune_ratio drops, from each table, the n-grams rarer than that share of its total, the table records the counts it kept from (pruned_below), and the importer refuses a table whose pruning changes a metric of its check layouts by more than its PRUNE_TOLERANCE (the table records the largest change, prune_check).
